name: Kyzyl-Chin Tract (“Mars”)
full: A tract (valley) in the lower reaches of the Kyzylchin River (a left tributary of the Chuya) on the northern edge of the Chuya Steppe, 4–9 km from the village of Chagan-Uzun (the turn off the Chuysky Trakt at km 863–864). Several sites: Mars-1 (the main one, with infrastructure), Mars-2, Mars-3 and “Luna” (the Moon).
near: Chagan-Uzun village (4–9 km by dirt road); Kurai village ~40 km; Kosh-Agach village ~50 km (estimate, not verified)
short: “Altai Mars” — colorful clay hills and outliers in red, orange, yellow and white shades on the edge of the Chuya Steppe, one of the most photogenic spots on the Chuysky Trakt.
desc: Kyzyl-Chin (from Turkic — “red”/“beautiful place”, or by other interpretations “red canyon”) is a tract (valley) in the valley of the Kyzylchin River near Chagan-Uzun. The multicolored slopes are made up of lake and marine sediments: according to Altapress, about 90 million years of geological history can be read here — a warm sea, then a huge freshwater paleolake of the Pliocene (5–6 million years ago) with more than 70 species of mollusks. The red and orange color comes from iron oxides (hematite, magnetite), other shades from compounds of manganese, chromium, titanium and copper; the white layers are calcareous (altai.travel, vpoxod). The myths about cinnabar and elevated radiation are not confirmed (Altapress). The sites: Mars-1 is the main tourist spot on the private grounds of a tourist complex: parking, a café, souvenirs, toilets, a playground, a pedestrian bridge over the Kyzylchin, costume rental for photos, paid entry (300 ₽, 2025); Mars-2 is brighter (purple and bluish tones), 3–6 km away, on foot or by SUV; Mars-3 (opened to tourists around 2019) and “Luna” are remote, accessible only by UAZs. Cinereous (black) vultures (Russian Red Data Book) nest in the cliffs, and the Pallas’s cat (manul) is found. In the vicinity is the Kyzyl-Chin polymetallic deposit (lead, zinc, silver; discovered in the 1950s).
guide: Come before lunch on a sunny day — the colors glow and the clay is not yet baking; after rain it is better not to venture here, as the clay turns into an ice rink. Don’t limit yourself to Mars-1: the most otherworldly views are at Mars-2, 3–6 km on foot or a UAZ drop-off for 1,500–2,000 ₽. Look up — cinereous vultures with a wingspan of nearly three meters circle above the cliffs. Don’t believe the stories about “mercury cinnabar” and radiation — they are myths. Take water and a sun hat: there is no shade here at all.
see: Mars-1 — viewing paths over the colored hills; Mars-2 — the brightest colors (purple/blue layers); Mars-3 and “Luna” — gray-white “lunar” landscapes; a panorama of the North Chuya Range beyond the Chuya Steppe; cinereous vultures.
skip: You do not have 2–3 hours to spare and the weather is rainy — the dirt road turns to mud, and on an overcast day the colors are dull. If you have already seen colored mountains (for example, in Kyrgyzstan), crowded Mars-1 may disappoint — then only Mars-2.
diff: Mars-1 — easy (short paths over the hills, with a gain of no more than ~50–100 m); Mars-2 — moderate (3–6 km one way over rough terrain, heat/wind); altitude ~1,900 m.
when: June–September (T—Zh); May–June and September (Khalva); from May to late June the ford across the Kyzylchin may be impassable because of snowmelt (altai.travel). September — fewer tourists, dry.
hours: Mars-1 operates in daylight during the tourist season (a ticket office at the lower site); exact hours not found.
daytime: The first half of the day in sunny weather (T—Zh); the low evening light also gives contrast.
how: Along the Chuysky Trakt to km 863–864, the turn to Chagan-Uzun, across the bridge over the Chuya and through the village following the “Mars” signs, then a dirt road across the steppe ~8–9 km with a ford/dry bed of the Kyzylchin — 20–30 min (T—Zh, awd.is, vpoxod). From Gorno-Altaysk ~430–438 km, 6–8 h; from Barnaul ~680 km.
needcar: Yes: a car to Mars-1; for Mars-2/3/“Luna” — an SUV or a UAZ drop-off.
self: Yes — to Mars-1 there are signs and a packed dirt road; for Mars-2 it is better with a GPS track or a local driver.
roadtype: Paved to Chagan-Uzun; then a dirt road with “washboard” and a ford across the Kyzylchin (altai.travel).
traveltime: Gorno-Altaysk → Chagan-Uzun 6–8 h; Chagan-Uzun → Mars-1 20–30 min (≈30 km/h, TripAdvisor 09.2025); a visit to Mars-1 — 1–1.5 h, with Mars-2 — half a day.
stay: Chagan-Uzun: Sofiyskaya Polyana base from 2,200 ₽ (a cabin for 3), MADI from 3,700 ₽ (mirturbaz, 2026), Kuyaktanar from 1,980 ₽ (8.5/10, 101hotels); the glamping site “Svoy Altai” (altai.travel); guesthouses 1,500–3,000 ₽ (Khalva); also Kurai (ails — traditional dwellings) and Aktash.
net: not found (per reviews the signal in the Chuya Steppe is patchy; at Mars-1 not confirmed)
entry: Mars-1: 300 ₽/person (T—Zh, 08.2025; TripAdvisor 09.2025; Khalva); earlier locals charged 150 ₽ per car without receipts (awd.is, earlier years). The fee goes to a private tourist complex, not a protected area.
transfer: A UAZ to Mars-2/3/“Luna” — 1,500–2,000 ₽ (2025); an excursion from Gorno-Altaysk — 12,700 ₽/person (2026).
bring: Water (there is nothing at Mars-2), sun protection and a sun hat, a windbreaker (strong wind), trekking shoes, cash for the entrance, a flashlight if you stay until sunset (Altapress, Khalva).
warn: After rain the clay is very slippery, and the dirt road and ford become impassable (T—Zh, altai.travel); in spring the ford can be deep. Altitude ~1,900 m, strong sun and wind, no shade. Border zone: the border zone in the Kosh-Agach District covers only part of the territory: under FSB Order No. 282 (2006) — the Jazator, Mukhor-Tarkhata, Tobeler, Kazakh, Tashanta and Kokorya rural settlements; by FSB Order No. 512 of 13.10.2022 Mukhor-Tarkhata, Tobeler, Zhana-Aul and Kokorya were additionally removed from the zone (Tashanta, Belyashi and Argut remained in the zone). Kurai, Kyzyl-Tash, Chagan-Uzun, Aktash/Chibit (Ulagan District) are not on these lists — according to the data found, no permit is needed for this place (medium confidence: no official answer from the Border Directorate for this specific point was found). General rules: for Russian citizens a passport is enough in the border zone, a permit is needed only for the 5-km strip along the border; foreigners need a permit for any point in the border zone (processing up to 60 days per the Saylyugem National Park website; 15/30 days per other sources). Where to apply: the FSB Border Directorate for the Altai Republic, Gorno-Altaysk, 94 Kommunistichesky Ave., +7 388-22 4-82-00, pugornyjaltaj@mail.ru; the office in Kosh-Agach, 2 Armeyskaya St., +7 388-42 2-34-70. Keep your passport with you — document checks on the highway are possible. Ticks: as of 25.08.2026 in the Altai Republic there were 3,600 reports of bites and 22 cases of tick-borne encephalitis (Rospotrebnadzor, the consumer-protection agency) — vaccination/insurance.
food: A café at Mars-1 (altai.travel, TripAdvisor) — menu/prices not found; in Kosh-Agach — Kazakh and Altai cuisine (baursaks, beshbarmak, kurut) — specific cafés not confirmed.
reviews: TripAdvisor: 4.5 (24 reviews), No. 1 in Kosh-Agach; the Sputnik8 excursion — 4.8 (49). Pros: “otherworldly” views, easy access to Mars-1. Cons: a paid entrance, crowds at Mars-1, dust, a long road (excursions of up to 16–17 h), a dirt road that is impassable in the rain.
